projects.name: Load Balancer
projects.action: A Layer-7 HTTP load balancer in Go spreading traffic across servers behind a single endpoint, with round-robin, least-connections, and latency-based power-of-two-choices routing driven by live in-flight counts and response times. Lock-free request path, active health checks, graceful shutdown, async SQLite logging, and a Next.js live dashboard. Tested with 600 requests against slow, fast, and 10%-failing mock servers.

projects.name: Speech-to-Text Workspace
projects.action: A real-time transcription platform routing audio across three engines: Groq Whisper, Google Gemini, and a self-hosted Whisper microservice (Whistle) containerised with Docker. Live audio streams over WebSockets, merging partial results into final transcripts and converting Indic scripts into readable Latin text. Includes transcript search, CRUD, and range-request audio playback.

projects.name: Smart Bookmark
projects.action: A bookmark manager that syncs across your devices. Uses Google Gemini so you can search your bookmarks with plain English queries. Jina AI scrapes pages into clean text before indexing. Has collections, favourites, a trash bin with 30-day recovery, and Google OAuth for sign-in.

projects.name: GitHub Commit Report
projects.action: Turns any GitHub user's commits into a plain-language daily summary with Groq. Skips already-reported commits via history in Google Sheets, routes the draft to Telegram for one-tap approval, and emails the confirmed version.

projects.name: Academia
projects.action: A student management app with three-tier role-based access across attendance, timetables, and exam results, backed by Node.js. Includes a progress dashboard, student profiles, and a notifications and events page surfacing updates to the right audience.

highlights: Led end-to-end development of the Production Plan across 7 facilities, processing 1.7k+ daily orders across 2,700+ SKUs with JWT authentication and role-based access controls.
Engineered order prioritisation, batch allocation (300–500 orders), and lifecycle tracking across work-in-progress, vacuum completion, and dispatch.
Automated batch-specific MRP label generation with QC markings, foam allocation suggestions based on BOMs, and scrap tracking for raw-material traceability.
Integrated QC and dispatch state validation to prevent wasted dispatches, implementing cancellation, shipper-weight, and shipper-allocation checks.
Built manufacturing inventory workflows for batch-based Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs) and QR-scan raw-material consumption with UUID-based QR label generation.
Engineered BullMQ background workers to synchronise Unicommerce inventory and calculate per-order raw-material consumption from BOMs.
Developed Vendor Replenishment workflows and a standalone Vendor App supporting inward processing with QR labels.
Created a 3PL warehouse stock dashboard with trend analysis, automated MOQ reordering, and norm-based stock-out alerts.
